Scenario TC-22/S25 — Task prompts are Vikram's wording; the UAT/prompt conflict on conditional and monitoring orders is flagged

Requirements it checks:
- T3: The task prompts and clinical rules are Vikram's prototype wording unless he approved a change
- U5: A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task
- U7: Monitoring-phrased physician orders are extracted as tasks

Given: handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (local copy of the TFA-94229 / TFA-92592 attachment) and convex/ai/prompts/library/v1/tasks/{system,encounter-review,post-note}.md (v1.1)
When: Compare the task system role, the encounter review and the post-note harvest with the prototype's task prompts
Then: Wording matches except changes Vikram approved. The p72 prototype already has 'EVERYTHING ELSE IS NOT A TASK: monitoring/trending instructions, … future conditional considerations' and the same four-category whitelist, so the exclusion is Vikram's own wording: list it for Q1 as a UAT-vs-prompt conflict, not a port deviation
Oracle: TFA-94229 AC 1 / R2 and TFA-92592 AC 13, reviewed by a person; the outcome feeds Q1, it does not decide S04/S05

- pending:Q1 — oracle: "the outcome feeds Q1, it does not decide S04/S05". Default: the conditional / monitoring exclusion is listed for Q1 (label pending:Q1), not as a port deviation

Gaps the matrix already records (use the id in a label only when the finding is exactly that gap):
- (none)

Compare the task prompts convex/ai/prompts/library/v1/tasks/{system,encounter-review,post-note}.md with the prototype's task prompts (handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html). The scripted sentence diff is in staticEvidence (parity-TC-22-S25.json): check its listed differences against the files yourself. Separately, quote the prototype's own wording on conditional orders ('future conditional considerations') and monitoring instructions, and say whether the app's prompts keep it (that is the UAT-vs-prompt conflict for Q1, not a port deviation).

pass = the wording matches the prototype apart from whitespace
fail = any wording difference (list each one)

- (none)
